Modbus Poll.name: Modbus Poll
Modbus Poll.subtitle: Modbus TCP/RTU Master & Slave
Modbus Poll.description:
Modbus Poll reads, writes and simulates Modbus devices from your Mac. Connect to a PLC, power meter, drive or inverter over Modbus TCP, or over RS-485 with a USB serial adapter, and watch every register update live.

MASTER
• Modbus TCP and Modbus RTU (serial)
• Read coils, discrete inputs, input registers and holding registers
• Write single and multiple coils and holding registers
• Data types: INT16, UINT16, INT32, FLOAT32 and FLOAT64
• Word order AB CD, CD AB or BA DC; decimal, hex or binary display; 0- or 1-based addresses
• Several read blocks per device, polled together
• Modbus exception codes shown on the rows they affect

SLAVE SIMULATOR
• Run a Modbus TCP or RTU slave on your Mac
• Device templates with live, changing values: Schneider Electric PM5560, SMA STP 60-US-10, Endress+Hauser Promag 10W, ABB AZL402, Emerson Daniel 1000 and a Raritan PDU
• Lock a register to hold its value while the rest keep changing
• Built-in virtual serial slave to test RTU without hardware

DIAGNOSTICS
• Traffic log with every request and response decoded
• Live trend chart for any register
• Scan a subnet for devices listening on port 502
• Scan an RS-485 bus across unit IDs and auto-detect serial settings
• Saved connection profiles, CSV import and export of read blocks, exportable logs

Requires macOS 13 or later. Modbus RTU needs a USB to RS-485 adapter (FTDI, CH340, CP2102 or PL2303).

Voltrus Connect subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://voltrus.id/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

BACnet Explorer.name: BACnet Explorer - Voltrus
BACnet Explorer.subtitle: BACnet/IP browser & simulator
BACnet Explorer.description:
BACnet Explorer finds, reads and writes BACnet/IP devices from your Mac. Use it to commission controllers, track down a wrong setpoint or learn how a building automation network is put together.

DISCOVERY
• Who-Is broadcast, with every I-Am reply listed by device instance, address and vendor

BROWSE AND WRITE
• Object tree of the connected device, grouped by object type
• Every property of the selected object
• Write present values with the right data type: Real for analog, Enumerated for binary and Unsigned for multi-state objects

LIVE TRENDS
• Chart any point live, by polling or by COV subscription
• COV subscriptions renew before they expire

ALARMS
• Alarm summary and event information for the device
• Acknowledge alarms

TREND LOGS AND SCHEDULES
• Read trend log buffers page by page and export them to CSV
• View weekly schedules and their effective period

DEVICE SIMULATOR
• Run a BACnet/IP device on your Mac from templates: an air handling unit, a centrifugal chiller and a VAV box
• It answers Who-Is, ReadProperty, WriteProperty and COV subscriptions, and a control panel lets you change its values while you test

Error, reject and abort replies from devices are shown with their reason, so a refused write never looks like a network timeout.

Requires macOS 13 or later.

FREE AND PRO
BACnet Explorer is free to download: discover devices, browse objects and read every property. A one-time Pro purchase adds writes with priority and relinquish, several devices at once, CSV export, an auto-refresh watch list, live COV trends, the alarm summary with acknowledge, the device simulator and the trend log and schedule viewers. If you bought BACnet Explorer before it became free, Pro is already unlocked.

Voltrus Connect subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://voltrus.id/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

EtherNet/IP Explorer.name: EtherNet/IP Explorer
EtherNet/IP Explorer.subtitle: EtherNet/IP CIP Tag Browser
EtherNet/IP Explorer.promotionalText: Find EtherNet/IP devices, browse and watch PLC tags, inspect CIP objects and capture packets. Test with the built-in adapter, no hardware needed.
EtherNet/IP Explorer.description:
EtherNet/IP Explorer is a native Mac tool for automation engineers who work with Allen-Bradley, Rockwell and other EtherNet/IP devices. Find devices on the network, browse controller tags, read live values and inspect the CIP objects inside any device.

DISCOVER AND CONNECT
- Broadcast a ListIdentity request and see every device that answers, with vendor, product name, revision and serial number
- Connect to a Logix or Micro800 controller by IP address
- Read the device identity at any time

BROWSE AND WATCH TAGS
- List every controller tag with its CIP data type
- Watch live values with an adjustable poll interval from 50 ms
- Switch the value column between decimal and hex
- Click a tag to read it on demand

EXPLORE THE CIP OBJECT TREE
- Standard classes such as Identity, TCP/IP Interface and Ethernet Link with decoded attribute names and values
- List the instances of any class
- Send Get Attribute Single and Get Attribute All requests from the CIP browser
- Load an EDS file to show vendor attribute names

TROUBLESHOOT
- Packet logger with every EtherNet/IP frame, a Tx and Rx filter and a hex view
- Communication log you can export as CSV

TEST WITHOUT HARDWARE
- Built-in EtherNet/IP adapter with ready-made device templates
- Open the adapter's control panel to change values, then connect to it from the scanner side of the app or from any other EtherNet/IP client

EtherNet/IP Explorer includes a free tier for discovery, tag browsing, live polling of up to 10 tags, the CIP object tree and the packet logger. A one-time in-app purchase called Pro unlocks unlimited live tags, tag writes, live trends, all CIP services, implicit I/O, custom response decoders, packet log export and the adapter simulator.

EtherNet/IP and CIP are trademarks of ODVA, Inc. This app is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ODVA or Rockwell Automation.

DNP3 Explorer.name: DNP3 Explorer
DNP3 Explorer.subtitle: DNP3 SCADA Master & Outstation
DNP3 Explorer.promotionalText: Poll any DNP3 outstation with your own point list, scan events by class, and test with a built-in outstation simulator. No hardware needed.
DNP3 Explorer.description:
DNP3 Explorer is a DNP3 master and outstation simulator for engineers who commission, test and troubleshoot SCADA systems in electric utility, water, oil and gas, and industrial networks.

MASTER
- Connect to a DNP3 outstation over TCP with your own master and outstation addresses
- Build your own point list: analog, binary, counter and status points with group, variation and index
- Poll the list on an interval and watch live values with a round-trip time readout
- Save a connection profile for each site
- Detailed communication log with CSV export

MORE WITH THE PRO PURCHASE
- Unlimited points in the poll list
- Controls: control relay output and analog output commands
- Class 1, 2 and 3 event scans
- Device controls: time sync, cold and warm restart, freeze counters
- Live trend charts
- Unlimited saved connection profiles

OUTSTATION SIMULATOR
- Start a built-in DNP3 outstation on your Mac and point any master at it
- Device templates such as feeders and transformers with live simulated values
- Event buffer with class assignment

The core features are available at no cost. Pro is a one-time in-app purchase that unlocks the rest.

Voltrus Tools.name: Voltrus Tools
Voltrus Tools.subtitle: 10 industrial protocols, 1 app
Voltrus Tools.promotionalText: Poll, simulate and trend Modbus, MQTT, BACnet, OPC UA, S7, EtherNet/IP, DNP3, NATS, serial and Bluetooth LE devices in one Mac app. Free to try for 14 days.
Voltrus Tools.description:
Voltrus Tools is the all-in-one suite for industrial protocols: the ten protocols you commission and troubleshoot with, in one native Mac window. Connect to a PLC, meter, drive, controller or broker, read and write its values, watch them live, and run a simulator of the other side on the same Mac when the real device is not on your desk.

PROTOCOLS
• Modbus TCP and RTU master: register blocks of any area and data type, word order, polling with automatic reconnect, writes to coils and holding registers, latency and error counters.
• Modbus simulator: serves a device template (inverter, power meter, flowmeter, analyser, flow computer, PDU) or a plain register image. A value set in the app or written by any master is held until you release it.
• MQTT client: TLS, username and password, wildcard subscriptions with QoS. Numbers, booleans, JSON fields and Sparkplug B metrics become points; publish any payload with QoS and retain.
• MQTT broker simulator: a broker on your Mac that publishes a device template, optionally as a Sparkplug B edge node.
• BACnet/IP client: Who-Is discovery, object list, change-of-value subscriptions, ReadPropertyMultiple polling, WriteProperty at a chosen priority and Relinquish.
• BACnet device simulator: an air handler, chiller or VAV box with a 16-level priority array and COV.
• OPC UA client: endpoint discovery, None, Basic256Sha256 and Aes security, anonymous, user or certificate sign-in; a keyboard address-space browser, subscriptions, typed writes and method calls.
• OPC UA server simulator: a process plant with units, ranges and methods.
• Siemens S7 client (ISO-on-TCP): S7-1200/1500, 300 and 400 presets; tags as you write them (DB1.DBD0, MW20, I0.3, T5); a PLC view with CPU identity, mode, diagnostic buffer and blocks.
• S7 PLC simulator: a motor drive, reactor or packaging line.
• EtherNet/IP (CIP) client: ListIdentity discovery, Logix tags by name, tag browse, CIP attributes, writes and explicit messages.
• EtherNet/IP adapter simulator with tags, assemblies and class 1 I/O.
• DNP3 master: integrity and event polls, time sync, freeze and restart; CROB and analog outputs by select-before-operate or direct operate.
• DNP3 outstation simulator: a feeder, transformer bay or solar plant with time-stamped events.
• NATS client: TLS, token, NKey or .creds sign-in, wildcard and queue subscriptions, publish, request and a JetStream browser.
• Serial monitor for USB, RS-232 and RS-485: text or hex terminal, macros, CSV logging and values parsed into points; a serial device simulator on a virtual port.
• Bluetooth LE scanner and GATT client: signal strength, services and characteristics, read, write and notify.

VIEWS
• Live points: every value with its address, name, unit, type, raw words and a sparkline of the last minute.
• Trends: multi-series charts from 30 seconds to 15 minutes. Series of very different size get their own lanes and scales.
• Traffic and log: requests and responses with their payloads, the requests a simulator receives, and every connect, failure and external write.
• Tabs and splits: watch a device and its simulator side by side. Layout and connections are restored at launch.
• Command palette (Command-K) and 492 colour schemes with live preview.

Each protocol has a demo on the welcome screen: a simulated device opens next to a client polling it, so you can try the app without hardware.

TRIAL AND UNLOCK
Voltrus Tools is free to download. Start the 14-day trial from the app to use every tool with no limits. After the trial, buy the one-time unlock to keep using them; there is no subscription. If you do not unlock, the app stays read-only: your saved connections, points, trends and logs still open, but connecting, simulating and writing to devices are locked. Restore Purchases is on the purchase screen and in About Voltrus Tools.

PRIVACY
Everything runs on your Mac. There is no account, and the app collects no data: no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting.
